title: Com Tam
description: Com Tam is a dish from Vietnam prepared with broken rice, pork chop, fish sauce, lemongrass. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Broken rice and grilled pork are used; optional pork-skin and steamed egg loaf sides are omitted.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 20 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 45 minutes.
Grill the marinated portions from the preceding steps, turning to cook evenly and checking the safe internal temperature.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 6 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
